description: Land Acquisition - Yodhagama, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are required for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, boundaries, and measurements) and falls under the "Land and property-related matters" category, making it a clear Type 4 (Land Gazette). While it mentions a Minister's name, this is incidental to the primary land acquisition purpose, and it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a Hybrid type.
